name: Axita Cotton Limited
summary: Axita Cotton Limited engages in manufacturing, processing, finishing, and trading of cotton bales, yarns, seeds, and agri commodities in India. The company also engages in ginning and pressing of seed cotton on job work basis. It serves traders, manufacturers, and merchant exporters. In addition, the company exports its products. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
